definitions.explanation: The part of the body at the end of the arm, used for grasping.
The entire upper limb from shoulder to hand.

examples.japanese: {手|て}を{洗|あら}ってください。

examples.english: My hands are free. / I'm not busy.
examples.notes: 手が空く = to be free

notes: Very versatile word with many expressions: {手|て}を{洗|あら}う (wash hands), {手|て}を{上|あ}げる (raise hand), {手伝|てつだ}う (to help). Compounds: {右手|みぎて} (right hand), {左手|ひだりて} (left hand).
